scoring_justification: Recomputing the CALPHAD equilibrium is infeasible in the lightweight verifier sandbox (requires the TCFE database and heavy computation). Absolute mass fractions vary with database version, so a structural audit of monotonic increase and magnitude range is the strongest feasible tier.

outputs.description: CSV with three rows (Co=3,6,12%) and columns Co_percent, corundum_mass_frac. The checker verifies that corundum_mass_frac is positive and within [1e-6, 0.05].

output_contract.notes: The checker performs a structural audit: it verifies the presence of rows for Co=3,6,12, checks that all mass fractions are within a plausible range, and verifies a required structural relationship between the three values. No exact numeric gold is required.
